title: finding(app-shell,i18n): two more designer unknown-value flags are hard-coded English: `FlowReferenceField`'s `(invalid)` membership tier and `HookDefaultInspector`'s `(not published)` object
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, read at source. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#9652 (PR objectui#10445, class a, two entries filed as one card as the dev suggested). The contract review of that PR confirmed both sites. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

objectui#9652 (PR objectui#10445) moved the designer's `(not in object)` / `(not found)` / `(deprecated)` flags onto the designer catalogue (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) through one word-order template, `engine.form.flaggedValue`, and a helper, `flagUnknownValue(value, flag, locale)`, in `inspectors/_shared.tsx`. Two more flags of the same class are still English literals. A zh-CN author reads them on an otherwise translated inspector. Read on objectui `origin/main`:

| site | literal |
|:--|:--|
| `inspectors/FlowReferenceField.tsx`, org-membership-level strict select | a stored tier outside the enum renders as `${current} (invalid)` |
| `inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx`, object picker | a selected object missing from the live catalog renders as `${n} (not published)` |

## Evidence

Read at source by the objectui#9652 dev and the PR's reviewer, and the seat re-read both lines on `origin/main`. ⛔ Not probed.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The fix shape exists once objectui#10445 lands: one new flag row per site (en and zh, e.g. `engine.form.invalid` and `engine.form.notPublished`) plus `flagUnknownValue`.
  - `HookDefaultInspector` already has a `locale` prop and a `tr` helper.
  - `FlowReferenceField` has no `locale` prop, so it reads `useMetadataLocale()`, as `FlowObjectListField` does in PR objectui#10445.
- Pin, per site: zh renders the value followed directly by the catalogue's zh flag, and en is byte-identical to today.
- ⛔ Serial behind PR objectui#10445: it adds the helper and the template this card reuses.
- It is the same grade class as objectui#9652 (p3).

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `(invalid)`, `(not published)`, `FlowReferenceField` near invalid / i18n / translate, or `HookDefaultInspector` near published / i18n / translate ⇒ 0 hits. The control `unknownValueLabel` / `notInObject` ⇒ objectui#9652, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `(invalid)` · `membershipLevelOptions` · `org-membership-level` · `(not published)` · `HookDefaultInspector pickerOptions` · `flagUnknownValue`
